episodeTitle.zh: 创始人背后的故事：德鲁·休斯顿（Drew Houston，Dropbox）

guestBioOfficial.en: Drew Houston is the co-founder and CEO of Dropbox. Under his leadership, Dropbox has grown from a simple idea to a service used by over 700 million registered users globally, with a valuation exceeding $9 billion. Drew has led Dropbox through multiple phases, from explosive viral growth, to battling all the tech giants at once, to reinventing the company for the future of work. In our conversation, he opens up about: •  The three eras of Dropbox’s growth and evolution
guestBioOfficial.zh:
德鲁·休斯顿是Dropbox的联合创始人兼首席执行官。在他的领导下，Dropbox从一个简单的想法发展成为全球7亿多注册用户使用的服务，估值超过90亿美元。德鲁带领Dropbox经历了多个阶段，从爆炸式病毒式增长，到同时与所有科技巨头竞争，再到为未来的工作重塑公司。在我们的对话中，他将畅谈：
• Dropbox增长和演进的三个时代

title.zh: 创始人背后的故事：德鲁·休斯顿（Drew Houston，Dropbox）

summary.en: Drew reflects on Dropbox's three eras: early 10x hypergrowth, then near-death competition as Apple, Microsoft, and Google launched rival products (Google Photos' free storage “nuked” their model), and a forced pivot to productivity. He shares the emotional toll—employees not wanting to wear the shirt, the narrative flipping—and the lessons of resilience and reinvention under existential threat. The conversation is a candid founder's story of surviving platform shifts and staying alive.
summary.zh: Drew 回顾了 Dropbox 的三个时代：早期十倍超增长，接着是苹果、微软、谷歌推出竞品带来的濒死竞争（Google Photos 的免费存储“核平”了他们的模式），以及被迫向生产力转型。他分享了其中的情感代价——员工不愿穿公司 T 恤、叙事反转——以及在生存威胁下韧性与重塑的教训。对话是一位创始人坦诚讲述如何在平台变迁中存活下来。
